defects.title: PUT endpoint has unused X-Idempotency-Key parameter
defects.invariant: API contract — every declared parameter must be consumed or explicitly documented as reserved; unused parameters leak surface and confuse clients
defects.mechanism: low-A.md:72 references V1-RMD-471 line :64 — PUT endpoint declares X-Idempotency-Key header parameter but does not read or validate it; parameter is present in OpenAPI/contract but ignored in handler
defects.acceptance: Either implement idempotency key validation for PUT or remove parameter from contract/OpenAPI; verify no unused parameters remain in any endpoint

defects.title: TCKN/VKN checksum validation missing — only digit count enforced
defects.invariant: Turkish tax ID (TCKN 11 digits, VKN 10 digits) requires modulus-10 checksum per official specification; digit-count-only accepts invalid numbers
defects.mechanism: low-A.md:72 notes plan only requires digit count; current validation checks length (10/11) but not the official checksum algorithm (TCKN: weighted sum mod 10; VKN: similar)
defects.acceptance: Implement TCKN (11-digit modulus-10) and VKN (10-digit modulus-10) checksum validation; add test cases for valid/invalid checksums; verify plan acceptance updated

defects.title: README references missing mutation-run.log file (only mutation-run-email.log exists)
defects.invariant: Documentation accuracy — all referenced artifacts must exist at documented paths
defects.mechanism: low-A.md:72 states README mentions mutation-run.log but only mutation-run-email.log exists in evidence; file reference is stale
defects.acceptance: Update README to reference actual file (mutation-run-email.log) or restore missing mutation-run.log with documented content; verify all README file references resolve

limitations: Source evidence is finding document (low-A.md) only; actual PUT endpoint code, TCKN/VKN validation code, and README not directly inspected. Defects inferred from finding text. Runtime behavior not verified.
